name: La Clochette
notes: All 3 photos were menus: a whiteboard, a printed soft-opening menu, and a laminated current menu. Items appearing on multiple were merged (whiteboard/laminated agreed on price); soft-opening-only items (oats, chia pudding, Marrakesh Medley, Farro Beet Salad) added separately. One description (Acai Power Bowl, laminated menu) had a word covered by a sticker and was left as-is without the obscured phrase.
